text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Mmh... Is my skin breaking out...?

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
"...The causes of rough skin are diet and lifestyle habits.
And—'tension resulting from external stimuli.'"

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Diet and daily routine are the same as usual.
All that remains is the nerves—

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
"I have had a succession of family-related parties lately.
......Hmm, so that is the cause."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Duramente seems to be troubled by rough skin...
